trajectory.route: deterministic Euler circuit over one directed traversal in each direction for every undirected graph edge
trajectory.edge_geometry: graph node -> explicit straight connector -> associated tunnel spline subarc -> explicit straight connector -> graph node
trajectory.endpoint_sampling: include route arc 0 and every exact 2m position strictly before the endpoint; each world is independent

mesh_clearance.query: Open3D unsigned closest-surface distance on the frozen native perception mesh
mesh_clearance.interpretation: perception-mesh trajectory feasibility only; non-watertight meshes remain ineligible for dynamic-navigation collision qualification
